lead.en: Derive sampled-gradient laws and noisy quadratic dynamics, specify momentum and adaptive updates, and connect penalties and stopping to a split-safe training experiment.
lead.zh: 推导抽样梯度律及噪声二次动力学，明确动量与自适应更新，并将惩罚和停止连接到遵守拆分的训练实验。

prerequisites.en: Modules 19, 23 and 25. Labs 1–2 use the pinned NumPy environment; Lab 3 uses the standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 19、23、25。实验 1–2 使用固定 NumPy 环境；实验 3 使用标准库。

en: Separate population risk, empirical objectives and conditional gradient sampling.
Derive replacement, subset and copied-batch gradient covariances.
Analyse expected smooth descent and a stable quadratic noise floor.
Specify momentum and Adam conventions without universal convergence claims.
Derive ridge, lasso, proximal and early-stopping effects in stated coordinates.
Audit clipping, adaptive decay, budgets and validation-based stopping.
zh: 区分总体风险、经验目标与条件梯度抽样。
推导有放回、子集及复制批次的梯度协方差。
分析平滑期望下降及稳定二次噪声底。
明确动量及 Adam 约定，不声称普遍收敛。
在指定坐标推导岭、套索、近端及提前停止作用。
核查裁剪、自适应衰减、预算及验证停止。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive conditional means and covariances.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推条件均值与协方差。

text.en: Read the population and empirical objective conventions.
text.zh: 阅读总体与经验目标约定。

title.zh: 噪声动力学与优化器定义

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and analyse recurrence stability and moment corrections.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，分析递推稳定与矩校正。

text.en: Compare batch laws under a fixed evaluation budget.
text.zh: 在固定计算预算比较批次律。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and distinguish regularisation from evaluation.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，区分正则化与评估。

text.en: Fit training-only scales and select ridge strength on validation.
text.zh: 仅在训练拟合尺度，并按验证选择岭强度。

text.en: Diagnose unstable rates, copies, clipping and adaptive decay.
text.zh: 诊断不稳定步长、副本、裁剪与自适应衰减。

text.en: Complete choices and write a training comparison contract.
text.zh: 完成选择并写训练比较约定。

text.en: Read the exact Adam and decoupled decay updates.
text.zh: 阅读 Adam 与解耦衰减的准确更新。

text.en: Complete the exit task and audit objective and evaluation claims.
text.zh: 完成结业并核查目标与评估声明。
